messages.content: 有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？

function.name: movies_search

message.content: 截至目前（2023 年底），全球票房收入最高的电影是《阿凡達》（Avatar，2009 年上映）。在多次重映和全球各地的票房累計後，其總票房已突破 29 億美元（約 292 億人民幣），保持了多年之久。第二名則是《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》（Avengers: Endgame，2019 年），其全球票房約為 27 億美元。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？" which means "What is the highest-grossing movie of all time?" They want the highest grossing film worldwide. That would be "Avatar" (2009) or "Avengers: Endgame"? As of 2023, "Avatar" remains the highest worldwide grossing film at about $2.92 billion. But we need to confirm. We can use the movies_search function? It expects title and year. But we don't know the title. We could search for "highest grossing film" but the function only searches by title and year. So maybe we can't use it. We can answer directly: "Avatar (2009)" with worldwide gross ~ $2.92B. Or mention "Avengers: Endgame" was second. Provide context. Also mention that due to re-releases, "Avatar" regained top spot. Provide answer in Chinese.
